claim: NASA confirmed that DART successfully changed the targeted asteroid's trajectory.
explanation: NASA confirmed that the DART spacecraft successfully impacted the asteroid Dimorphos, which altered its orbit around the larger asteroid Didymos by 32 minutes [s1]. This mission demonstrated that NASA can intentionally collide a spacecraft with an asteroid to change its orbital path [s2]. Multiple sources confirm the success of the mission in nudging the asteroid out of its natural orbit [s3].
